prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single isolated transparent PNG sprite for an existing 2.5D painted interior website.
Primary request: design one compact, low HORIZONTAL tabletop speaker, inspired by the refined oak-slat grille and thin understated frame of B&O Beosound Level but with a custom low landscape proportion about 2.6:1 width to height. No logo, no lettering.
Input image1: room illustration ONLY for paint style, camera/perspective and warm palette. Do NOT output the room.
Design: a soft rectangular low box with a warm walnut/light oak front of about 18 distinct vertical wood slats, deep charcoal gaps showing the speaker grille behind, a thin matte charcoal casing and subtle subdued champagne inner rim. Tiny two dark rubber feet touching the bottom plane. The full front clearly visible, almost frontal view with a VERY slight view of the top face matching the desk in reference. Level horizontal baseline. No dramatic 3/4 perspective.
Style: match the hand-painted matte gouache / 2.5D illustrated room exactly. Clearly visible broad soft brush shapes, lightly uneven hand-painted edges, simplified slats, small warm highlights. NOT photorealistic, NOT a commercial product render, no crisp photographic grain, no shiny chrome, no CGI perfection.
Lighting: soft neutral warm studio light from upper left, with gentle cool-gray shadows. No dramatic blue ambient light; runtime will tint the asset per time.
Composition: one entire small wide speaker centered, wide landscape image, transparent empty margins no more than about 5-8% on each side. Speaker body about 85% of image width; all feet visible. Preserve actual transparent background/alpha. Very subtle contact shadow immediately under the feet only.
Avoid: tall cylinder, oak pedestal, stacked objects, separate speaker pair, stand, handle, antenna, giant knobs, text, watermark, table surface, room/background, checkerboard pattern drawn into image.
